name: White Breath in the Cold (smoky Mountain Mist Kata)

system.description: The character takes a deep breath, holding her ring fingers together and holding the middle and index fingers of one hand to the index and middle fingers (respectively) of the other. So doing, she focuses power carefully into her heart chakra and breathes out a fine, damp mist. For (her Essence x 10) yards, she creates an area of poor visibility (as detailed on p. 135 of Exalted) that lasts as long as she maintains her gesture. Characters aspected to Smoke or the Mountain who learn this kata tend to breathe out clouds of white smoke or finely ground dust rather than mist.
